info.title: The Cube private practice API
info.description: Architecture draft for milestone M5; no server is implemented. Cookie writes require CSRF protection; native bearer tokens are an alternative. Proposed limits and retention are detailed in the architecture documents.

servers.description: Same-origin planned API base; no provisioned service implied.
